notes: This decision is a fail-closed architecture disposition, not a claim that the experimental stack failed or that the current architecture won.
The pilot gate was structurally valid but incomplete, froze an empty nonbaseline shortlist, and did not authorize holdout access.

The holdout remains sealed and unopened. Zero scheduled pairs and zero kernel-verified successes describe the absence of authorized execution; quality, resource, and complexity efficacy values remain null and not observed.
A0 is retained only as the unchanged current reference. A1 through A12 are evidence-ineligible for production promotion, and S1 remains a diagnostic that can never be selected.
No benchmark result changes production routing, promotes a component, merges a worktree, or authorizes tuning against holdout outcomes.

results.evidence: evidence-bound final architecture decision, delegation matrix, and worktree-safe reproduction runbook

decision.rationale: Required paired holdout evidence does not exist because the capability-preflight pilot produced no eligible nonbaseline shortlist and correctly withheld holdout authorization. Retaining the current route unchanged preserves the production reference without interpreting absent measurements as evidence for or against any experimental component.

execution_accounting.interpretation: Counts are zero because holdout execution was not authorized; they are not zero-valued efficacy, safety, latency, resource, or complexity measurements.

domains.reason: No paired holdout cases were authorized or observed; capability missingness cannot be scored as failure, success, or no change.
Preflight zero-call records do not measure the runtime or resource cost of an eligible candidate, and no holdout pair ran.
The implementation contracts expose these costs, but absent paired candidate execution supplies no measured delegation value or operational burden.

rejected_alternatives.reason: No component has paired holdout evidence establishing unique kernel-verified benefit and acceptable resource and complexity cost.
No P0-P3 policy completed the frozen shortlist and paired holdout gates.
No stratum-specific paired holdout quality, safety, resource, or routing metrics were observed.
The absence of eligible candidate measurements cannot establish superiority of A0.

required_follow_up: Restore and pin the requested full spaCy pipeline, SyMAI and llm_router provider/model identities, and Leanstral endpoint/model identity without changing the frozen protocol, corpus, variants, prompts, policies, thresholds, or selection inputs.
Re-run capability probing and the unchanged pilot and development matrices with complete case-result, telemetry, resource, and independent native-kernel receipts.
Validate a complete pilot gate with zero kernel-verified invalid-control false positives, non-null efficacy and cost evidence, and a frozen non-empty shortlist of at most four eligible candidates.
Open holdout only after that gate explicitly authorizes access; execute A0 and every exact shortlisted arm on the identical frozen holdout manifest in balanced cold and warm pairs without tuning.
Replay every holdout success and sampled failures in fresh detached worktrees and isolated namespaces, then validate complete safety, quality, latency, resource, routing, and complexity reports.
Publish a replacement final-decision artifact only if the source-bound paired holdout gate validates; production promotion remains a separate reviewed action and is never performed by this benchmark.
